systems.name: 2.1 ART & Palette Loading
systems.notes: Witchaven/TekWar use .ART tiles with custom palettes (PALETTE.DAT). Ensure the tool can load these and correctly render textures in the preview. Provide batch loading for all game ART files.
tasks: Support loading multiple ART files and merging tile sets
Correctly apply Witchaven's palette (256 colors) to all tiles
Add palette auto-detection from game directory

systems.name: 2.2 Texture Remapping to Doom Names
systems.notes: Build picnums must be mapped to human-readable texture names in UDMF. Create default mapping tables for Witchaven textures and allow user overrides via the remapper UI.
tasks: Create remapping presets for Witchaven 1/2 and TekWar
Load and use external WAD texture definitions for Doom equivalents

systems.name: 2.3 Visual Preview with Textures
systems.notes: The preview canvas already draws floor polygons with tile images. Extend to wall textures (or at least correct palette) and sprite rendering with correct rotations.
tasks: Draw wall textures on 2D top-down view as lines or filled polygons
Ensure sprite images use correct ART tiles and are not stretched
Add palette cycling preview if needed
